name: Spuskaemiy apparat
about: Spuskaemiy apparat (1965-092, MOM), launched 1965 Nov 16. Its phases from GCAT: Venus, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.694 au and aphelion 0.997 au against GCAT's 0.680 and 0.990
